tools: a skill's finds come faster (speed = time taken), from `level` in that skill
Cam (2026-10-04): "Make use of stone maybe by some beginner stone tools, that have a limited
durability but for mining the durability of a stone pick is 1 pick per copper or tin ore as
they are weak. They should also cost a fair bit of stone to make and twigs as we need to
balance with the fragment system". Tier 0: only the soft rocks and trees (spot.soft);
`wear`: used up after `uses` finds (of `on`, when given). Made at your Crafting bench.
(2026-10-10, Cam: "my stone pick feels like it went to fast without gaining much copper") -- the 9 October pace change
had cut these to 1 and 15 finds; a stone tool now lasts 300 finds above its tier (copper, tin, birch...), enough copper
and tin for a bronze pickaxe with plenty over. Stone, clay and flint never wear it.
